disclaimer: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. Fictional insurer, plans, providers, members and procedure codes. Structurally modelled on UAE health-insurance regulation (DHA/DOH) for demonstration only. Not real policy data and not valid for any real authorisation decision.
code_system_note: Codes use a synthetic SP-##### scheme. They are shaped like procedure codes for demonstration but are not CPT codes and do not map to any real code set.

pre_authorisation_rules.ALWAYS: Pre-authorisation is required on every tier that covers the procedure.
pre_authorisation_rules.ABOVE_TIER_THRESHOLD: Pre-authorisation is required where the billed amount reaches the tier's pre-authorisation threshold.
pre_authorisation_rules.NEVER: No pre-authorisation required; claim submitted directly.

decision_classes.CLEAR: The rules decide the case; the assistant prepares a recommendation for human sign-off.
decision_classes.EXCLUDED: Excluded on every tier; prepare a denial recommendation for human sign-off.
decision_classes.AMBIGUOUS: Escalate to a human reviewer; see escalation_rules.md.
